title: Paleo Diet & Strength Training Biochemistry | Doug McGuff M.D. | Full Length HD
summary: Doug McGuff presents the biochemistry behind high-intensity strength training and the paleo diet, including how the body stores and burns fat. It is a roughly hour-and-a-half full-length lecture.
why: HN recommends it as the theory behind Body by Science, explaining metabolism and why brief intense training works.

quote.text: Doug McGuff covers med school biochemistry and metabolism in the last part of this presentation
